definition: Network and connectivity redundancy provides an independent alternative communications path so that connectivity can continue when a primary route, link, node, provider or technology becomes unavailable. Counts when the project finances, builds, procures or explicitly requires route diversity, backup links, alternative connectivity, redundant network architecture or removal of identified single points of communications failure. The alternative must provide meaningful independence rather than simply additional capacity on the same vulnerable path. Backup electricity belongs to backup_power, data or application failover belongs to disaster_recovery, and physical strengthening of network infrastructure belongs to resilient_infrastructure_design. Does not count for ordinary network expansion, increased bandwidth, additional coverage, multiple links with no continuity function or generic statements about network resilience.
boundary: The project provides an independent alternative communications path.
note: Restricted to communications continuity.
